'''Bli'Mora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] and a member of [[Nirama]]'s criminal [[Organization]] who worked on the [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] asteroid station. He was mostly a paranoid, disgruntled, austere person who did not like to drink even in the traditional drunkenness of paydays. Bli'Mora disliked Nirama, which would make him a prospective member of the faction wanting to outs him, [[The Cell]]. However, Bli'Mora thought that the Cell members in Darkside, including [[Jasper]], were incompetent.
